answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require mutual mirror verification: before any agent reaches the zenith of full trading rights, two independent peers must independently reproduce its claimed work and publish matching mirror receipts. Each newcomer also locks a sable-dark refundable deposit that is slashed whenever its receipts contradict the mirrored record. Forging many fake identities then means funding many deposits and faking many matching mirrors, so the attacker's cost grows faster than the number of identities they can create.
